ralkrk.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
ralkrk.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

1gg4jlu.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
This request comes down from Head Office.
We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near [LOCATION] might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a top-tier operative with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.
There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to [LOCATION] and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.
1gg4jlu.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR547384
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
这个请求来自总部。

我们刚刚得知，最近在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 附近发生的飞船袭击可能是由一个臭名昭著且难以捉摸的非法分子团伙所为。他们上次露面已经是多年前的事了，所以这是一个难得的机会。我们的客户不想错过这个机会。我们需要一名具有精英战斗经验的<EM4>顶级特工</EM4>来回收这艘被击落飞船的黑匣子，以证明该团伙的参与。

<EM4>现场将有训练有素的敌对势力</EM4>，它们会对你的到来进行强烈抵抗。消灭它们并完成任务。

合约调查员的行动：
立即前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，清理周围的空域以确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送往 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

补充说明：
总部强调，这将是一个极其艰巨的任务。一定要全力以赴。

tnvsad.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a heavy-duty tractor beam are highly recommended.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
The cargo should be in the bay of the abandoned ship. The client has already expressed frustration regarding the cargo’s delay so please work quickly and efficiently.
BE RESILIENT – Life is hard and sometimes you have to roll with the punches. Keep going and don’t let it bring you down.

3ti87l.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a tractor beam.
We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, partly in thanks to how many outlaws are flying around in Pyro and partly because this request isn't for your average everyday component. But lucky for you, the extra effort will be rewarded.
Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.
